metadata.name: Adjustable Glass Dashboard
metadata.description: A responsive glass workspace with adjustable blur, opacity, saturation, tint and edge lighting. Data-driven dashboard views include searchable activity, savings goals, reports and CSV export, with GSAP transitions and host-theme support.
metadata.author: automate_flows
